isolation.scope: read-only repository inspection plus report/evidence writes under assigned paths

assertions.title: TypeScript types renamed

steps.action: Search frontend TS/TSX for clearly frontend-owned old naming residue from the rename set
steps.expected: No frontend-local daimon/muse naming remains after the round-2 fixes
steps.observed: The exact `mouseDaimonTuning` identifier no longer appears, but frontend-local `museRuntimeSnapshot`, `musePresenceId`, `requestedMusePresenceId`, and `Mouse daimon` / `Mouse Daimon` comments still remain in live source.

steps.action: Review remaining old backend wire-format fields separately
steps.expected: Interop fields may remain only where needed for backend compatibility and should not be the primary failure reason for this rerun
steps.observed: `witness_thread`, `fork_tax`, `ghost`, and `daimoi_probabilistic` are still present in response typing/access paths; they were treated as backend interop context rather than the main failure basis here.

assertions.issues: Round 2 removed the exact `mouseDaimonTuning` identifier, but the rename cleanup still fails because clearly frontend-owned old naming remains in local variables, function parameters, and comments (`museRuntimeSnapshot`, `musePresenceId`, `requestedMusePresenceId`, and `Mouse daimon`/`Mouse Daimon`).

assertions.title: No transparency backgrounds

steps.action: Check the previously reported transparency utility classes in frontend TSX/CSS
steps.expected: The prior `bg-white/70`, `bg-white/55`, and `bg-black/40` residues are gone
steps.observed: Those exact classes no longer matched in current frontend source.

steps.action: Inspect current live panel/container background classes for any remaining translucency
steps.expected: Panel and container surfaces use only solid dark backgrounds
steps.observed: Current TSX still includes translucent panel/control backgrounds such as `bg-sky-50/70` in WorldSimulation and multiple `bg-white/5` / `bg-transparent` surfaces in PresenceCallDeck.

assertions.issues: The exact round-1 class names were partly cleaned up, but the assertion still fails because live TSX panel/container surfaces continue to use translucent background utilities instead of solid dark backgrounds.

assertions.title: No galaxy/parallax backgrounds

steps.action: Search current frontend source for the previously reported cosmic-effect residues
steps.observed: No current matches were found for those effect terms in part64/frontend/src.

steps.action: Inspect remaining galaxy-related matches and ignore functional component naming alone
steps.expected: No visible galaxy wording remains in active UI copy
steps.observed: GalaxyModelDock.tsx still renders the visible strings `galaxy model dock` and `in-galaxy management`, so user-facing galaxy wording remains even though the earlier effect residues appear removed.

assertions.issues: The earlier radial-gradient/vignette residue appears fixed, but the assertion still fails because active UI copy still exposes galaxy wording in GalaxyModelDock.tsx.
